The '''Military Vacuum Suit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. The suit was in common use throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained enough [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to last for ten [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]].
